subject: Initiate Security Review & Buying Steps for Stax Health (post-demo recap)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Erik Olson <erik.olson@staxhealth.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@staxhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Initiate Security Review & Buying Steps for Stax Health (post-demo recap)

Hi Erik / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, this thread is to kick off the security intake and to map the buying path so we can align timelines and owners. Summary and immediate asks below.

Quick recap (from the call):
- Primary use: clinical decision-support notes generation, low-latency inference at scale.
- Desired go-live window: Q4 2026 (pilot in October).
- Key concerns: PHI handling, audit logs, model pinning/version control, data residency.

Stakeholder map as we understand it (please correct):
- Economic buyer: Dana Ruiz (VP Product) — final sign-off on spend
- Security reviewer: Erik Olson (InfoSec lead) — controls and evidence
- Procurement / Legal: Priya Sethi — contract terms, procurement PO and vendor onboarding
- Customer success / Eng ops: internal contacts for rollout (we'll work with you on runbooks)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement path (PO vs contract) and target procurement lead?
2) Please complete the attached security questionnaire and the short systems inventory (attached XLSX) for a first pass of "in-scope" systems. If you prefer, we can take this live in a 30-minute kickoff.
3) Share any mandatory compliance evidence gating the contract (SOC2, BAA requirements, encryption-at-rest keys, KMS/HSM policies).

Attachments: stax_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (fillable), systems_scope_inventory.xlsx
Shared links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSecurityKickoff (we put the questionnaire and a short post-demo playbook there)

Tentative schedule suggestion: security kickoff week of Sep 21, procurement timeline TBD — would love to firm both up by Sep 17.

I'll loop Monica (security engagement lead) and Ben (contracts) so we have immediate support. Looking forward to getting this started.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_post-demo-playbook.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks Mina —

Confirming procurement path: Stax uses PO + contract for new SaaS vendors. Procurement queue is run by me; I own the vendor onboarding checklist. High level timeline from our side: vendor intake and security pass (2 weeks), legal redline (1 week), PO issuance (1–2 weeks) — so your Q4 target is reasonable if we start this month.

Economic buyer: Dana Ruiz (cc'd). Dana will sign off on budget but expects a short ROI write-up.

On the security questionnaire: we'll pass the attached to our InfoSec team. Erik will lead the technical answers.

Attaching: initial vendor intake form (we'll fill the rest after kickoff).

Priya Sethi

> Thanks Mina —
> 
> Confirming procurement path: Stax uses PO + contract for new SaaS vendors.

Thanks — quick updates from InfoSec side:
- We'll run the questionnaire and the systems inventory. My initial note: anything handling PHI will be strictly in-scope (EHR connectors, inference endpoints that accept PHI fields).
- Evidence required early: SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 in progress + interim evidence), architecture diagram, data flow diagram showing PHI boundaries, audit log retention settings.
- Encryption: need details on KMS integration and key custody options (bring-your-own-key is preferred).

Schedule: I can join a 30-minute kickoff on Tue Sep 21 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed Sep 22 14:00–15:00 PT.

I've attached a lightly annotated version of your questionnaire with a few clarifying Qs inline.

Erik Olson
InfoSec, Stax Health

- BYOK options: we support KMS integrations and can provide a short technical runbook for KMS/HSM by Sep 21.
- For the kickoff, Tue Sep 21 10:00 PT works for our team.

Action items and owners: 
- Mina: confirm kickoff invite and high-level agenda (by EOD today)

- Ben: prepare a draft SOW and procurement checklist (by Sep 23)

- I'll prepare a draft SOW + standard Master Service Agreement redline and share by Sep 23.

Look forward to the kickoff on Sep 21.
